tagline: Victoria's Secret & Co. is the world's largest intimate apparel company with leading brands in intimates, beauty and lifestyle.
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI measures store productivity, a key indicator for a retail business. It reflects how efficiently selling space is utilized to generate revenue.

kpis.short: Sales per Average Selling Square Foot
kpis.name: Sales per Average Selling Square Foot
kpis.explanation: Store productivity indicator, calculated by dividing store sales by average selling square footage.
kpis.description: Measures sales performance per unit of selling space in stores operated by the company.

kpis.name: Sales per Average Store
kpis.explanation: Store productivity indicator, calculated by dividing store sales by the average number of stores.
kpis.description: Represents the average revenue generated by each store operated by the company.

kpis.name: Total Selling Square Feet
kpis.explanation: The total square footage dedicated to sales across all company stores.
kpis.description: Indicates the overall size of the company's physical selling footprint.
kpis.signal: Slight reduction in selling square footage, potentially due to optimization.

kpis.name: Adjusted Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Operating profit before certain exceptional or non-recurring items.
kpis.description: Measures the company's operating performance by excluding items considered non-representative of ongoing operations.
kpis.signal: Improvement in operating profitability after adjustments.

kpis.short: Adjusted Net Income Attributable to Victoria's Secret Co.
kpis.name: Adjusted Net Income Attributable to Victoria's Secret Co.
kpis.explanation: Net income after taxes, adjusted to exclude certain non-recurring items.
kpis.description: Represents the company's final profit after all expenses and adjustments, attributable to shareholders.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in adjusted net income.

kpis.short: Adjusted Net Income Per Diluted Share Attributable to Victoria's Secret Co.
kpis.name: Adjusted Net Income Per Diluted Share Attributable to Victoria's Secret Co.
kpis.explanation: Adjusted net income divided by the total number of outstanding shares on a diluted basis.
kpis.description: Indicates the company's profitability per share after adjustments for non-recurring items.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement in adjusted earnings per share.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of $5.01 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of $2.85 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Adore Me Long-Lived Assets Impairment
kpis.explanation: Exceptional charge related to the impairment of Adore Me brand assets.
kpis.description: Non-recurring cost resulting from the impairment of tangible and intangible assets related to the Adore Me brand.

kpis.name: Interchange Fee Settlement
kpis.explanation: Exceptional gain resulting from the resolution of a credit card interchange fee dispute.
kpis.description: Net gain resulting from the settlement of a litigation matter concerning credit card interchange fees.

kpis.short: Adore Me and DailyLook Fulfillment Center Restructuring
kpis.name: Adore Me and DailyLook Fulfillment Center Restructuring
kpis.explanation: Charge related to the restructuring of logistics operations for Adore Me and DailyLook brands.
kpis.description: Exceptional charge resulting from unique operational disruptions that led to the restructuring of order fulfillment operations.

risks.title: Tariffs
risks.score_rationale: Tariffs constitute a significant risk for the company, which relies heavily on imports. Regulatory uncertainty can affect gross margins and consumer pricing.

risks.title: Cybersecurity Incident
risks.score_rationale: A cybersecurity incident occurred in 2025 affecting computer systems and direct channels. The immediate impact was temporary but demonstrates vulnerability to cyberattacks.

risks.title: Intense Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive market with numerous traditional and digital competitors. Differentiation and customer acquisition are major challenges.

risks.title: Technology Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on technology for its direct channels and back-office operations, making it vulnerable to outages and cyberattacks.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in over 70 countries with significant activities in Asia and Europe, making it vulnerable to geopolitical risks, regulatory changes, and sanctions.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to numerous complex regulations, particularly regarding data protection, product safety, and environmental compliance. Regulatory changes can increase costs.

risks.title: Reputation Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is vulnerable to reputation risks, particularly in the event of cybersecurity incidents, product quality issues, labor practices concerns, or media scandals.

ai_positioning.summary: The company has not mentioned AI, machine learning, or similar terms in the provided excerpts from its 10-K/20-F filing. Therefore, its AI positioning cannot be determined from this information.
